# Kadó

> Gift digital dollars to anyone, no wallet needed. An event gives each attendee a code; they tap Open and, in one Stellar transaction, get their own funded Stellar account. No app, no seed phrase, no email, no fee to pay. Runs on Stellar testnet.

Built for HackMeridian 2026 (Genesis track, thematic track Stellar Unlocked). The whole product uses two native Stellar protocol features and no smart contract:

- Claimable balances (CAP-23): each gift is locked on-chain for a public key whose account does not exist yet, with a time predicate that returns it to the organizer if nobody opens it.
- Sponsored reserves (CAP-33): the organizer carries the new account's reserve, so the attendee starts at 0 XLM and the gift arrives whole.

Opening is one atomic transaction (beginSponsoringFutureReserves, createAccount with starting balance 0, endSponsoringFutureReserves, claimClaimableBalance), signed by a channel account, the sponsor and the attendee key. Either the account is created and the gift is delivered, or nothing happens. There is no database: all state is read from Horizon.

## Try it

- [Home and code entry](https://kado-hackmeridian.vercel.app/): type a demo code and tap Open
- [Demo codes](https://github.com/eduruizhipolito/kado-hackmeridian#try-it-judges): 30 testnet codes, each opens once
- [Organizer panel](https://kado-hackmeridian.vercel.app/panel): generated, opened, open rate and time to open, read from chain
